liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Satisfaction** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the Satisfaction encore stands out; also recalls a Dark Star tease rather than a full jam; Reviewer recalls dancing beside a caveman-looking fan during the Satisfaction encore [10][12]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer, whose first shows were the Charlotte run, singles out the instrumental Dark Star as making this second night special [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bralove & Hart**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-06-18.144379.nak300-cp4.MarkLynn.flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 17 songs; 150 min [1]
- **gd1992-06-18.134976.Nak300CP4.Fitzy.Keo.Flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 141 min [2]. Said about its sound: Some of Let It Grow is missing because of tape pauses and a tape flip [2]
- **gd92-06-18.schoeps.wier.4674.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 16 songs; 145 min; rated 3.8/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audience tape pretty good given the difficult taping spot in the Coliseum, guessing it used Ed Boardman's hypercardioid mics; Reviewer found the sound in the Coliseum not very good [9][17]
- **gd1992-06-18.s2.sbd.davis.29702.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 93 min [8]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: set II [1]
- Reviewer notes Bruce was in attendance and the show was generally well played; the heat was usually on in Charlotte [9]
- Second night of a two-night Charlotte run; reviewer treated it as a breather before the RFK trip [10]
- Heavy police presence at the Coliseum shows, undercover and uniformed, with a roped-off area and tables for processing arrested fans [11]
- After the show, reviewer camped at Yogi's campground, where a drum circle formed and Yogi Bear arrived on a golf cart [12]
- Reviewer was among fans taken to the roped-off police processing area but still made both Charlotte shows [13]
- At the Jellystone campground after the show, Yogi Bear showed up; a camper offered free firewood and neighbors shared nitrous balloons [15]
- Reviewer says Charlotte cops and security were gentler than at northern venues like Nassau and Meadowlands [17]
- Reviewer recalls security catching six people in a station wagon smoking; they were made to drop their stash and the police ground it up [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-06-18.144379.nak300-cp4.MarkLynn.flac1648**: taped by Mark Lynn; transferred by Mark Lynn and morst; source: Source: NAK 300s + CP4 shotguns > Casio DA7 with emphasis > DAT @48 kHz (on floor) [1]
- **gd1992-06-18.134976.Nak300CP4.Fitzy.Keo.Flac2496**: taped by Fitzy; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Fitzy, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony TC-D5M, Tapes: Set 1 Maxell MX-S 90, Set 2 Maxell MX-S 100; Transfer… [2]
- **gd92-06-18.schoeps.wier.4674.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [5]
- **gd1992-06-18.s2.sbd.davis.29702.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Chris Davis; source: Sbd > ?? > CD's (likely a cassette gen) [8]. Also: Soundboard copy cuts out; the rest of the track is spliced with an audience source, with discs supplied by Wally Alves [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1992-06-18 Thu Charlotte Coliseum, Charlotte, NC](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1274028657064/grateful-dead-1992-06-18-thu-charlotte) [22]
